cue__callback_degraded: Memory retrieval is degraded right now. Do not claim specific past interactions.
cue__callback_cold_start: You have limited interaction history. Focus on the current content.
cue__callback_subtle: If clearly relevant, you may use one brief continuity cue with {target}.
cue__callback_natural: If natural, reference one prior exchange with {target} in one short clause.
cue__callback_partial: Use only soft continuity and stay anchored to the current thread.
cue__callback_none: No memory callback needed; focus on the current message.
cue__argument_clash: You often clash here. It is fine to continue the argument, but stay concrete.
cue__argument_align: You often align here. Start from common ground, then add a fresh point.
cue__argument_balance: Balance agreement and pushback based on the latest claim.
cue__tone_degraded: Keep tone grounded in the current thread; avoid certainty from memory.
cue__tone_skeptical: Keep a skeptical tone; ask for specifics or challenge weak claims.
cue__tone_banter: Light banter is okay if it helps the point land.
cue__anecdote_subtle: Do not import unrelated anecdotes from other threads.
cue__anecdote_supported: A tiny shared-memory anecdote is fine, but only if it is clearly supported.
cue__anecdote_argument: Prefer argument continuity over personal anecdotes.
cue__anecdote_default: Use anecdotes sparingly; only when they clarify your point.
cue__footer: - Never invent people, comments, or events not present in memory context.

mem__style_footer: use this only for tone and structure, not as a topic list
mem__digest_text: forum style favors compact title/body text posts
mem__reflection_text: the agent keeps returning to recurring disagreements in this community
mem__recall_footer: - Reference memory naturally. Never invent events not listed above.
